entry_state: Debt contracts, carrying measurements and cash flows require separate records. Apple's principal, cash and hedge adjustments do not identify all movements; net borrowing can hide refinancing. Disclosed sensitivities retain their population and measure, and derivative VaR is not net company currency risk. The equity section now introduces security quantities, monetary equity and dated per-share calculations, which continue next.
exit_state: Basic EPS uses the dated split-adjusted share denominator and attributed ordinary earnings. Options and convertible debt pass the sequential continuing-earnings dilution test, while preference shares fail after those admissions. The same admitted population determines total and discontinued EPS. The finite ordered selector has been introduced, with its assumptions and derivation continuing on page 184.
findings: Share dates use half-open intervals and preserve the actual historical register separately from retrospective split adjustment.
The numerator removes NCI and current preference entitlement before testing potential shares; prior-year dividend payment is not another current deduction.
The convertible's coupon, effective interest, tax benefit and issue-date share weighting are distinct; the stated cash schedule supports its supplied liability amounts.
Preference shares look dilutive against basic EPS but are antidilutive after options and debt, demonstrating why the continuing-operations control and order matter. No new confirmed defect.
